text: Fixed. `relativedelta` now converts whole-number floats for `years`/`months` to integers, so `datetime(2000, 1, 1) + relativedelta(months=1.0)` returns `datetime(2000, 2, 1)` and `years=1.0` behaves like `years=1`. Genuinely fractional values (`years=1.5`, `months=1.5`) still raise `ValueError` as documented. Verified: full test suite green (1064 passed, 43 skipped).

Fixed. `count=0` is now treated as a real (empty) bound instead of being ignored: `rrule(YEARLY, count=0, dtstart=datetime(1997, 9, 2, 9, 0))` yields no dates and `rr.count()` returns 0. Positive counts, `until`, and the `bysetpos` path are unaffected. Verified: full test suite green.

Fixed. `str(rrule(...))` now emits the `RRULE:` prefix, e.g. `DTSTART:19970902T090000\nRRULE:FREQ=YEARLY;COUNT=5`, and parsing a string that already contains `RRULE:` and printing it back preserves the prefix. Verified: full test suite green.
Investigating the fuzzy parser's handling of the `p` token in the URL path.
Investigating the IndexError on a trailing colon with fuzzy=True.
Investigating relativedelta.__add__ dropping explicitly-zero absolute values.

Fixed. In fuzzy mode, an AM/PM-looking token that is not actually an AM/PM marker (no hour yet, or already an AM/PM flag) was being silently swallowed instead of being treated as skipped text. It is now recorded as a skipped token, so `parse("http://biz.yahoo.com/ipo/p/600221.html", fuzzy_with_tokens=True)` returns `(datetime(2060, 2, 21, 0, 0), ('http://biz.yahoo.com/ipo/p/', '.html'))`. Full test suite green (1064 passed, 43 skipped).

Fixed. The `HH:MM[:SS]` branch indexed `l[i+1]` after only checking `i < len_l`, so a trailing colon ran off the end of the token list. The seconds sub-branch is now guarded with `i+1 < len_l`, so `parse('2017-07-17 06:15:', fuzzy=True)` returns `datetime(2017, 7, 17, 6, 15)` (the stray colon is skipped) instead of raising. Full test suite green.

Fixed. `relativedelta.__add__`/`__radd__`/`__sub__` used `other.day or self.day`-style truthiness, which discarded an explicitly-set `0`. They now use `is not None` checks, so `relativedelta() + relativedelta(day=0, hour=0)` and the reverse both keep `day=0, hour=0`. Full test suite green.
